title: The Hermit of Filolial
paragraphs: “It’s just a little while longer, you know.”
“Got it.”
So, I took the old man with me toward the castle town to recruit him for our party.
“I’ll guide you properly, so all you have to do is agree.”
“Sigh…”
After the old man gave his permission and I confirmed he’d joined the party, I used the portal to teleport back. It was a close call with the cooldown.
“W-where are we!?”
“A quest?”
I’ll guide the old man to the deep mountains where I’ve taken Fleon-chan to safety.
“Is that Filolial-sama over there the one we’re looking for?”
Fleon-chan spots us and flutters over, flapping her wings.
“Ah, ah… but that figure… is that the Filolial Queen from the legends? I’m pretty sure there were rumors she’d been spotted in Melromarc…”
Oh, so he knows about the Filolial-sama… This old man seems to be quite knowledgeable about Filolial-sama.
“That power from earlier, the soldiers’ attitude, and the way she holds that spear…”
“Of course! I am the Spear Hero and The Love Hunter, Motoyasu Kitamura! It seems I should start by explaining the situation and offering my apologies.”

I bowed my head to the old man. After all, he is Fleon-chan’s true owner. And I must offer a sincere apology. After all, I let Fleon-chan die in the first world. Apologizing won’t make it right, but I’ll apologize anyway.
“The reason I ended up confiscating your precious Filolial-sama this time was because I wanted Filolial-sama in the first place.”
I explained to the old man how I had met Filo-tan.
“So, you’re saying that when the Spear Hero desired the Filolial, Princess Malty—who was disguised as an adventurer—used her power to take my precious Filolial egg away…”
“That’s exactly it. I offer my deepest apologies for this matter. Filolial-sama… Fleon-chan and I have named her.”
After all, I didn’t know this fact until this loop.
“Guaaaaaa.”

Freon-chan is rubbing up against me and the old man. She looks absolutely adorable. It seems Fleon-chan’s wings and tail feathers are just a little longer than those of the other Filolial-sama. They’re sparkling—she has such beautiful plumage.
“Once we’ve ensured her safety… I’ll return Fleon-chan to you.”
As soon as I said that, the old man began stroking Fleon-chan’s face.
“To have raised such a magnificent Filolial in just a few days… the power of a hero is truly astonishing…”
The old man looks at me, no longer with that tearful expression he’d had before, but with a somewhat cheerful look on his face.
“No… for this child’s sake, Spear Hero, I shall give this Filolial to you. That would be best for her.”
Oh… what generous words. However, there’s a fact here that I simply cannot accept so readily.
“May I ask a question first?”
“What is it?”
“Fleon-chan… why can she fly? I’ve heard that Filolial-sama are extinct.”
“Ah… I suppose I need to explain first… Where should I begin… Let’s start with me, then.”

The old man began by explaining his own background. Apparently, this old man had been a Filolial breeder for a very long time, with a wide-ranging and diverse operation. It’s said he was such a prominent figure in the Filolial racing world that people would say, “If there’s anyone in the Filolial racing scene, it’s him.”

He crossbred and raised various bloodlines… There was a time when he was completely obsessed with creating Filolials that were as fast, talented, and tough as possible. Eventually, unable to defy the passage of time, he entrusted his legacy to his disciples, retired from the racing scene, and set out on a carefree journey to observe Filolials across the land.

Then, one day… while searching for a Filolial he had yet to see, the old man reportedly found a nest deep in the mountains—one that wild Filolials must have built long ago. Carefully sealed with Magic, inside… there was said to be a single egg. That location was a region where, according to ancient lore, flying Filolials once lived… It is said that the old man brought the egg—seal and all—back with him and kept it safely.
“Didn’t you hatch it to bring about the resurrection of Filolial-sama?”
“…It’s true that I was troubled by that. Spear Hero, do you know why the flying Filolials went extinct?”
“If I recall correctly… I heard they went extinct in a conflict with the griffins.”

The griffins of this world are truly foolish creatures, you see. Apparently, they’re driven by unfounded fears—like that horses might take their place—so they attack on a whim; or they’ll swarm a dragon in a group, claiming, “Anything valuable belongs to us!”; or they’re constantly picking fights left and right. Because of that, they’re also at odds with Filolial-sama. It seems they get along well with Takt—I suppose they’re just a good match.
“That’s the direct cause, yes. However… indirectly, humans were involved as well.”

Since Filolial-sama could fly through the skies at a lower cost than dragons or griffins, they were apparently subject to rampant overhunting. It was already an era when people were desperately seeking ways to counter the rampaging griffins. Flying Filolials were hunted to extinction across the land and exploited for the sake of conflict. The old man told me that a hero and a genius were involved behind the scenes.

In any case, humans played a role in the extinction of the flying Filolial-sama. The old man worried that if the flying Filolial-sama were to return, the same conflicts might arise again—and that it might lead to the Filolial-sama shedding blood once more. That is why, he said, Fleon-chan’s egg has remained sealed all this time.

My, my… It’s true—it certainly breaks my heart to see the Filolial-sama wounded and falling. It brings back memories from the loop in which I revived Shieldfreeden. There’s no way I, Motoyasu, could fail to understand this old man’s feelings!

“And just a few days ago, while I was carefully safeguarding this little one inside the egg… a soldier from the kingdom and a red-haired female adventurer, having heard rumors about me, barged in, claiming they were seeking a valuable Filolial egg… They forcibly snatched the egg from me, broke the seal, and took it away.”

It’s definitely the Crimson Swine! I see—this old man is actually a well-known figure around here, and they must have heard he possessed something amazing and decided to steal it! This is an absolutely unforgivable crime!
“And so, I came to the castle to get the egg back. And… the Spear Hero has kindly allowed me to watch this little one hatch.”
“I see…”
“Kue?”
Fleon-chan is flying through the sky while tilting her little head. Every now and then, she strikes a pose to show off for us. She’s just like Kuro-chan.
“Such a magnificent Filolial… It’s an ancient species called the Filolial Fimonoa.”
Oh… so it’s an extinct species. That’s amazing, Fleon-chan!

Come to think of it, my Father mentioned this back in the first world. He said that the Crimson Swine, other pigs like it, and the reincarnated ones were going around eliminating things that were useful to this world. Apparently, there are also important facilities and people in the places where the waves occur.
And the Crimson Swine poisoned Fleon-chan, whom he’d taken from this old man. Given Fleon-chan’s origins, she surely isn’t unconnected to this. It feels as though everything has come together now.
“Now a weight has been lifted from my shoulders… O Spear Hero, please take good care of Fleon.”

The old man… no, the one I must now respectfully call the Filolial Sage—he pleaded with me. To think such a wonderful person existed in this world… I’ve experienced many worlds over a long time, yet there are still so many things I don’t know. As I looked at Fleon-chan, a certain emotion welled up inside me.
“I’m afraid, Immortal, I’m not qualified for that.”
“Huh? Immortal? But more importantly… what do you mean by ‘qualified’?”
The Immortal looked puzzled by my words. But I had to say it.
“I… lost this little Fleon in another world. At the hands of the one who took her away from you, Immortal.”
“A-another world?”
“That’s right. If I, who knew nothing, had been taking care of little Fleon back then… by now, she would’ve been killed by those bastards!”
Just remembering it makes my blood boil with hatred. It’s infuriating! “Her body couldn’t adapt to the changes, so she died of illness,” you say? No! Fleon died because you poisoned her!

“Immortal, I’m telling you this because it’s you. For some reason, I possess the power to travel back in time. Thanks to that, I was just lucky enough to be reunited with Fleon-chan. In the first world, Fleon-chan had already passed away, and I didn’t know anything about you, Immortal.”
“I-Is that so?”
The Immortal seems unable to wrap his head around the situation. It’s no wonder—it’s hard enough just to get my Father and the others to believe me.
“Anyway, Immortal, Fleon-chan—whose precious egg was forcibly taken and who was killed in another world… don’t you want to avenge that?”
“N-no… I…”
“I know without you having to say it. The grief of the Immortal, who was given back the corpse of Fleon-chan—who was more precious to him than his own life…”
“Even if you say that, I’m still at a loss… It’s easy to imagine. He must have lost all confidence in carrying on with his life.”

I suppose so. What the Crimson Swine did deserves a thousand deaths. Is there any way we can show the Immortal an outcome he’ll find satisfactory and avenge that grievance? Neither I nor the Immortal will be satisfied if the Crimson Swine just turns into a mess of dirty fireworks in a Burst Lance!

At that point, a brilliant idea came to mind. It’s the work of the torture techniques passed down directly from my Father—techniques I honed while planning to kill Takt in the most gruesome way possible! Thank you so much, Big Sister!
Oh? My father from the first world is saying, “Did you develop this on your own, learn it from me, or get it from Sadeena? Pick just one.” HAHAHA, it’s all of them!
“I’ve got it! Immortal, I’ve come up with a great plan, so please wait here with peace of mind.”
“Huh?”
“Ah… um… I see. So what am I supposed to do…”
“I’ll give you some money, so please wait leisurely in Melromarc’s town for a while.”
With that, I hand the money to the Hermit. After all, there’ll surely be plenty of things I’ll want to learn from this Hermit!

First, to put the brilliant plan I’ve come up with into action, I’ll need to retrace the events of the first world to some extent. I need to figure out what to do about Ren and Itsuki, keeping future developments in mind. After all, my Father ordered me to handle this as peacefully as possible the time before last…? Hmm? I think that was the time before last, but I also have memories from in between. I don’t have the time to dig deep into my memories, you know.
Ugh… Filo-tan.

Anyway, my kind Father asked me to keep an eye on Ren and Itsuki if possible. That’s right. Since I was able to reunite with Fleon-chan, the first Filolial… it might be a good idea to introduce Ren to Black Thunder. However, since Ren can be a bit stubborn, I’ll have to make the Black Thunder a bit stronger. Either way, regarding the Wave… to set things up so that incident happens, it’d be best if I deliberately put up a tough fight and pretend to lose, letting Father take the spotlight.
After all, Fleon-chan has grown up quite a bit by now. Even if she doesn’t participate in the “Wave,” let’s have her watch from nearby.
“Fleon-chan”
“Kue?”

“I’m fighting against the ‘Wave’—an event that threatens to plunge this world into crisis. I want Fleon-chan to witness the battlefield as well. For certain reasons, I’ll pretend to lose, but you absolutely must not come out, Fleon-chan.”
“Kue? Kueh!”
Fleon-chan nodded in agreement, accepting my request. What a good girl.
“Now, I’ll take Fleon-chan near where the Wave is going to happen, so please watch from there.”

And so, I teleported Fleon-chan to the site of the Wave, while I returned to the castle with the Immortal. After parting ways with him, I chatted with Crimson Swine and Trash for a bit before preparing for the Wave.
3… 2… 1… and the wave struck. The location was exactly as I remembered—near the village where the old woman of the Hengen Muso Style lives.
Well then… just as I was about to proceed as I’d remembered—whoosh! A huge shadow came hurtling toward me, trying to kick me.
“Eeeeeek!?”
I dodged it quickly, and there stood Filo-tan. Oh no…
“Huh? The Spear Guy dodged it? Next!”
“Eeeeeek!?”
Whoosh, whoosh—Filo-tan is kicking right at me! This is scary! I need help!
“Eeeeeek!”
“W-what’s going on, Motoyasu? Why are you making such a strange noise?”
“What was that scream?”
Ren and Itsuki heard my voice and turned around.
“Oink-oink! Oink-heh!”
The Crimson Swine is making some kind of racket. It’s so noisy!
“Setting aside Motoyasu’s slightly amusing voice… you guys…”

My father scolded me, Ren, and Itsuki, looking thoroughly exasperated. He’s absolutely right. Precisely because we have to faithfully recreate the original world, I didn’t do it—but honestly, I really wanted to follow Father’s instructions as much as possible.
“Calm down. And think. Since I don’t receive any financial aid, I won’t fight the main body of the Wave. My job is simply to protect the nearby towns and villages. Do you understand that?”
“Yeah.”
“You’re unfit to be a Hero.”
“I’ve been entrusted with this, after all.”

My Father furrowed his brow in displeasure, but it can’t be helped. After that, he scolded us for not bringing the Knights’ Order with us. Relying on my memory, I ended up giving a reply that made me look like a complete idiot. I was truly foolish back then—it makes me want to tear my hair out.
“Hmm?”
The way Filo-tan kept moving her legs as if she were slashing at the air… it was really scary! All I could do was pray, “You absolutely must not kick my Father!”
